summary: The note is a short biographical entry for Beatrice Van, an American silent film actress who also worked as a screenwriter on both silent and sound films. It gives her birth and death dates and places, Omaha, Nebraska and Long Beach, California.
one_line: Beatrice Van was an American silent film actress and screenwriter, born in Omaha, Nebraska, in 1890 and died in Long Beach, California, in 1983.
